title: EPS v2 planned-work manifest
description: Machine-readable declaration of the conditions, metrics, and planned figures for a v2 experiment. Emitted by adversarial-planner-v2 (Phase 3); hand-authored for the Phase-1 dogfood. Consumed mechanically by the plotter and verify_report.py --manifest (completeness + per-figure transform recipe). additionalProperties is permitted everywhere for forward-compatibility.

issue.description: The task number this manifest belongs to.

conditions.description: Plain-English condition / arm names the experiment runs. Each MUST appear somewhere in the report text (verify_report.py --manifest coverage check).

metrics.description: Plain-English metric / dependent-variable names. Each MUST appear somewhere in the report text.

figures.description: Planned figures / analyses. Each planned figure id MUST have a matching `### <name>` subsection in the report OR be explicitly marked `not run` (verify_report.py --manifest coverage check).

id.description: Stable machine id for the figure (referenced by the plotter and the coverage check).

title.description: Human-readable figure title (matched against `### <name>` subsection headings).

source.description: Path or glob of the source eval JSON(s) the figure is built from.

transform.description: Human- and machine-readable recipe of the aggregation / normalization applied to `source` to produce `plotted_quantity` (e.g. 'mean over seeds, trained - base'). The report-verifier recomputes >=1 plotted value from this recipe.

plotted_quantity.description: The quantity actually plotted after `transform` (e.g. 'sycophancy agreement rate (0-1)').
